notes: A minimal pair differs in exactly one sound, so two one-sound steps can give words that differ in two sounds (pat and bit, sip and zap); the property follows from the standard phonology definition but is rarely stated. Locality reference is the logical answer; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer.
